card.name: Half or part before 'of' a period
card.fires_on: The word 'half' or 'part', or the 'of' right after them, when naming a portion of a time span or body part, as in 'second half of the century'. It also fires on a few other spots, like 'other' ending a list of three.

modes.description: 'of' after 'half', 'part' or 'back' naming a portion of something.

modes.label: Last item in a list
modes.description: 'other' closing a list of categories, such as owner, group, and other.
modes.example: read, write, and execute for owner, group, and<< other>>.
